decisions.quote:
In line with our
replication hypothesis

2011

,

decisions.reason: The complete2011primary proves an empirical delayed-keyword versus no-keyword relative-accuracy finding, separately from later restudy selection; changed child/adult population or omitted regulation does not exclude conceptual retesting. It explicitly re-tests the2003/2005keyword-effect chain, and current tests the same generation-control gamma contrast before its new expert-keyword optimization. This closest positively verified component is the appropriate existing-row139original replacement rather than an additional pair beside the2005mechanism citation. Complete2005has delayed/immediate, thinking and yoked-keyword comparisons but no passive no-keyword arm; its role is not erased, yet the exact current control contrast is positively established in2011. Correct139below and exclude2003/2005ancestors from extra export; do not count one current chained contrast multiple times. The inaccessible2017component remains separately unknown, not assumed absent or report-equivalent.
